meta.title: DSI 60-Day Work Schedule and Deliverables
meta.subtitle: File handoff for the existing project system | October 22–December 20, 2026
meta.dateNote: Day 1 is October 22. Execution ends December 16 (Day 56); December 17–18 are review/recovery (Days 57–58); December 19–20 are weekend closeout watch only (Days 59–60). No new mandatory weekend work.
meta.actualsNote: No completed outputs or future actuals are assumed. Source historical baseline through October 22: 4,101 emails, 8 total replies including auto-replies, 0 positive replies and 0 bookings. New actuals remain blank until recorded.
meta.sharingNote: Tasks track execution and evidence. CQL remains the sole prospect/opportunity system. Use CQL IDs/links; do not duplicate patient/prospect sensitive data.
assumptions: All times use America/Los_Angeles. The November 1 clock change is handled as local Pacific time; do not use a fixed UTC offset.
Nine named internal owners receive a daily output or health-check task. Brian and Ludwig release reserved time when no fault or approved work remains.
Setter 1 and Setter 2 remain staffing roles until Nova records actual names, hours, breaks and backup coverage. Their proposed 40-hour weekly allowances are unapproved capacity assumptions.
November 26–27 is a proposed holiday break. November 23–25 is reserved for agreed callbacks, training and recovery. Confirm client and staff availability at the reset call.
Original proposal and reset targets are operating goals, not guarantees. Intermediate daily and weekly pace is a new planning allocation.

The original proposal recommends 40 outreach hours per month. Reset source caps total 125 internal hours per build week, plus setters; this tracker reserves 117 internal hours per normal later week including 2 for Brian. Wyline must confirm internal recovery funding; these are not new DSI charges.

Advertising, custom integration, advanced CRM work, additional operators and production or kit costs require the applicable separate funding approval. A staffed manual lane can launch without waiting for optional AI automation.
Advertising spend defaults to zero until written approval. The reset recommendation is at most $15/day and $450 total, with a $300/zero-booking stop.
Forty qualified inquiries is a proposed recovery target for December 16. Qualified inquiries, verified raw contacts and appointments are distinct counts.
Recurring-account results require an eligible Day-30 review and a signed recurring plan. Later trial cohorts carry their real review dates into January.
New cutoffs, Wyline split-block availability and client response requests must be adopted or adjusted at setup. Office starts are confirmed; shift ends are not.

Ali and Chester are proposed support assignments because their office starts are known but DSI scope and weekly allocation were not supplied. Each proposed lane uses at most 2.5 hours/week and requires assignment before loading as active work.
Twenty original social posts implement the confirmed 50/30/20 mix. Platform mirrors are distribution, not additional content units. Approval of every exact version remains required.

Wyline owns DSI campaign strategy, LinkedIn paid-media setup and conversion decisions, social-calendar accountability and daily acceptance. Kenneth owns content strategy; Emman builds/tests AI creative and media-buying support workflows. AI does not independently approve claims, spend or its own completion.

sourceNotes.issue: Source ends Dec 19; user ends Dec 16 with earlier Dec 18 mention
sourceNotes.resolution: Move execution cutoff to Dec 16 and use Dec 17–18 recovery/review; keep source outcome targets as planned targets, not guaranteed results.

sourceNotes.issue: 500 verified before any send versus 250 launch gate
sourceNotes.resolution: Use detailed dated launch gate: 250 QA-passed before Nov 3; 500 by Nov 6; 750 by Dec 11. Never send unverified rows.
Oct 31→Oct 30; Nov 7→Nov 6; Nov 14→Nov 13; Nov 21→Nov 20; Dec 12→Dec 11. No mandatory weekend work.
Register has 12 SOPs after ADS/SOC additions; core scorecard includes 12 source outcome/service metrics with referral and LI rows.

sourceNotes.issue: Facebook/Instagram parked versus adopted latest amendment
sourceNotes.resolution: Apply §17 d: mirror approved posts to Facebook; permissioned-image posts also Instagram; no separate content production or Meta ads.

sourceNotes.issue: Source refers to 3 DMs, 2 DMs and 5-touch LI SOP
sourceNotes.resolution: Prepare complete 5-touch sequence plus connection note and objections; use approved SOP when supplied; never improvise unsupported claims.

sourceNotes.issue: 10–15 min Nic calls versus 30 min LI discovery
sourceNotes.resolution: Confirm calendar at Oct 27 reset: default 15 min intro; 30 min discovery only in dedicated Nic-approved slots.

sourceNotes.issue: Source guarantee fallback without approved terms
sourceNotes.resolution: Do not publish unapproved guarantee; hold offer lane until written terms. Approved neutral relationship copy may be used separately only after Wyline/Nic approval.

sourceNotes.issue: Retarget-only early source versus local conversion campaign §17 b
sourceNotes.resolution: Use latest §17 b: one local conversion campaign if written budget/tracking approved; matched audience only after platform eligibility confirmed.
Plan cohorts and prioritise due follow-ups; 150 includes all touches. Activity counters are ceilings conditional on remaining capacity.

sourceNotes.issue: Global 20% cap cut every 2 weeks versus coverage duties
sourceNotes.resolution: Record as source aspiration; implement only with validated automation, workload and service coverage, not automatic staff reduction.

sourceNotes.issue: Original proposal promised qualified inquiries and appointments
sourceNotes.resolution: Add 40 proposed qualified inquiries and first-win checkpoints. Keep contacts, inquiries, appointments and trials separate; use original six-month range as context, not as a fabricated contract guarantee.

targets.label: Verified contacts ready
targets.definition: Unique contacts passing Scout and loaded in CQL; count once per contact.
targets.source: PDF §§10, 14; 750 due Dec 12 moved to Fri Dec 11

targets.label: Qualified inquiries
targets.definition: Unique ICP-matched practices that express relevant interest, need or timing; Nova records practice type, decision-maker access, case volume, service need and readiness within 30–60 days. Raw records, opens and connection accepts do not qualify.
targets.source: Original proposal pages 2 and 4 define qualification; 40 by Dec 16 and intermediate pace are newly proposed recovery targets.

targets.label: Qualified conversations booked
targets.definition: Unique qualified calls/visits booked with Nic; rebooking same opportunity is not a new booking.
targets.source: PDF §10; final deadline advanced to user Dec 16

targets.label: Qualified conversations held
targets.definition: Completed qualified calls/visits; 6 and 15 are integer planning proxies for 70% of 8 and 75% of 20.

targets.label: Trial cases received by DSI
targets.definition: Practice’s first trial case received by DSI, not merely promised or shipped; subject to Maseeha capacity.
targets.source: PDF §10; final deadline advanced to user Dec 16

targets.label: Recurring accounts signed
targets.definition: Plan signed following Day-30 review; only mature trial cohorts eligible. 1–3 is a conditional range.

targets.label: Permission-based referral introductions
targets.definition: Unique introductions with consent and referrer recorded, verified by Maseeha within 2 business days.

targets.label: Referral-sourced bookings
targets.definition: Subset of booked total with primary Source=Referral; never added on top of all-channel bookings.

targets.label: LinkedIn DM-sourced bookings
targets.definition: Subset of booked total with primary Source=LinkedIn DM; assists tracked separately.

targets.label: Human reply rate
targets.definition: Unique emailed contacts that give a qualifying human reply / unique contacts emailed in the same send cohort. Exclude OOO, auto-replies, bounces and unsubscribe-only replies. Deduplicate contacts across sequence steps; zero denominator is N/A.

targets.label: Positive reply rate
targets.definition: Unique emailed contacts classified interested or relevant question / unique contacts emailed in the same send cohort. Deduplicate across sequence steps; zero denominator is N/A. Keep this email rate separate from all-channel qualified inquiries.

targets.label: Replies answered within 15 minutes
targets.definition: Human replies requiring a response that receive a human answer within 15 staffed Pacific-business minutes / all such replies whose response deadline has passed. Exclude OOO/auto-replies, bounces and unsubscribe-only notices; record suppression separately. After-hours clocks resume at the next staffed opening. A zero denominator is N/A.
targets.source: PDF §9; clock convention clarified for tracker

targets.label: Held rate
targets.definition: Qualified conversations actually held / unique booked conversations whose scheduled time has passed. Exclude upcoming appointments. Rebooking the same opportunity is not a second booking. A zero denominator is N/A.

targets.label: Positive-to-booked conversion
targets.definition: Unique email-positive opportunities booked / unique email-positive opportunities in the same reviewed cohort. Use a documented follow-up window. This differs from the all-channel 40-inquiry/20-booking planning assumption. A zero denominator is N/A.

targets.label: Existing-account referral asks
targets.definition: Ask 25 unique A/B accounts (5 A and 20 B) by November 13; proposed pace 35 total by November 20; complete the remaining C accounts to reach 41 total by November 25. One introduction is the ask; asks and received intros are separate counts.
targets.source: PDF §16 supplies 25 A/B by Nov 14 and 16 C by Nov 25; Friday deadline and 35-by Nov 20 pace are proposed scheduling allocations.

targets.label: Approved SOPs
targets.definition: 10 core SOPs plus ADS-01 and SOC-01 additions; approved version and independent-run evidence required.

targets.label: Accepted AI agents
targets.definition: Scout, Writer, Inbox, Phone Assist, LinkedIn Assist, Follow-up, Scoreboard and Client Reporter; acceptance evidence required.

sops.name: Social intake, proof, approval and mirroring

rules: A task becomes Accepted only after evidence and Wyline/reviewer sign-off. Review is not completion.
Original due date never changes. Recovery date and rescue owner are separate fields. Blocked work stays visible across dates.
Blocked owner records reason, impact and help needed at once; Wyline assigns backup at next checkpoint, immediately for reply-SLA risk.
If an agent misses its due date by 48 h, use its manual SOP; live failure rolls back within 1 h. Critical approvals cannot be bypassed.
Reply targets apply during confirmed 8 am–5 pm America/Los_Angeles coverage. The named on-shift backup takes an overdue reply immediately; Nova owns the roster and escalation during her office time.
Source cap 150 total sends/day includes all follow-ups. Do not treat 150 as new contacts/day. Remove bounces/unsubscribes and replied contacts from pending touches.
LinkedIn 20–25 new requests/day is a ceiling/working target only while eligible verified contacts and account permission allow; stop on platform warnings.
Source setter 50 dials/8 office conversations per staffed day and 5 bookings/week by week 3 are stretch productivity assumptions, not additional booking promises; inbound SLA wins.
Keep one primary booking source per opportunity. Referral 8 +LI 8 are components of 20 total; email/phone/ads share remaining 4 in the plan.
No new cold enrollments during Nov 23–27. Confirm holiday coverage; no scheduled mandatory work Nov 26–27. Warm-up may continue automatically.
Do not cut human capacity automatically. Review source 20% fortnightly reduction only after tested agents, no backlog and SLA protection; Wyline records decision.

Paid ads remain at $0 until Nic’s written approval. Proposed ceiling : $15/day and $450 total; stop at $300 with 0 attributed bookings. One booking at $300 triggers review, not automatic continuation.
One social master calendar. Exact approved posts mirror to DSI LinkedIn/Facebook; Instagram only if a permissioned image exists. No new Meta ads.

Overall recovery planning uses 40 qualified inquiries to support 20 bookings at an assumed 50% inquiry-to-booked rate. This is an all-channel planning assumption; the source 50% positive-email-to-booked metric has a different denominator and remains separate.

The original six-month proposal is a reference for client expectations. First qualified inquiry, first booking and first held call are the immediate win checkpoints; report honest incremental recovery results each Friday.

The sixty-day social mix is 20 originals:10 Engage/6 Educate/4 Promote; SOC20 on Nov 30 is the proposed extra Engage post. Promotions Nov 3,Nov 17,Dec 1 and Dec 15 are 14 days apart. Prior-approved versions only.

Handoff times are proposed planning cutoffs. Confirm availability at setup; do not infer unprovided shift end times. Wyline uses split DSI blocks within 15 h/week, not a continuous six-hour DSI shift.

Map CSV/JSON into the existing system; no import capability is assumed. Match stable IDs. Do not overwrite live actuals, evidence, status, original due date, review history or accepted timestamps with blank planning values.

risks.risk: Signed terms, sender consent or client calendar missing
risks.trigger: Any hard approval absent at Oct 30 gate
risks.response: Hold affected launch; escalate to Nic with dated decision. Use approved existing relationship outreach only; no unapproved guarantee.

risks.trigger: Gaps in 8 am–5 pm PT or SLA<90% for 2 days
risks.response: Take overdue replies personally; assign confirmed backup; throttle intake before reducing response quality.

risks.trigger: Weekly estimate above cap; booking calendar or trial slots unavailable
risks.response: Prioritize replies/phone/follow-ups; lower enrollments; move one lower-priority build with original date retained.

risks.trigger: After 500 unique emailed, human<2% and positive<1%
risks.response: At Wyline review change one ask/proof variable; move effort to phone; do not add channels.
Confirm office days; use callbacks; maintain booked follow-through; target full outcomes by Dec 11 to create buffer.

risks.risk: AI output error or dropped webhook
risks.trigger: Invented claim, missing reply, failed acceptance
risks.response: Stop drafting; manual SOP within 1 h; dead-letter replay and regression evidence before restart.

risks.risk: Verified LinkedIn pool smaller than request goal
risks.trigger: No fresh eligible verified profile or account warning
risks.response: Work accepted connections/replies; do not invent contacts or exceed limits. Record actual eligible pool.

risks.trigger: Trial begins after Nov 16; Day-30 after Dec 16
risks.response: Book actual Day-30 date beyond sprint; report as future review cohort, never prematurely recurring.

promiseMap.resetAction: Record actual interest/need/timing and the 5 qualification fields in CQL; separate raw list from inquiry.
promiseMap.resetTarget: 40 qualified inquiries by Dec 16 (proposed recovery goal)
promiseMap.evidence: Unique CQL practice IDs; qualification fields and reply/call evidence
promiseMap.gapOrApproval: 40 is an incremental recovery goal, not the original whole-term commitment.

promiseMap.resetAction: Fix sender/offer/list; coordinate email/phone/LI/referrals; human reply<=15 min during coverage.
promiseMap.resetTarget: 20 booked and 15 held by Dec 16; first booking/held by Nov 6
promiseMap.evidence: Unique appointment IDs; scheduled date; held outcome and source
promiseMap.gapOrApproval: Original planning ranges are not guarantees; report actual recovery against the existing plan.

promiseMap.resetAction: Written First Case Guarantee terms, capacity check, kit/logistics and trial received verification.
promiseMap.resetTarget: 6 cases received by DSI by Dec 16
promiseMap.evidence: Case receipt date, owner, eligible terms and delivery/review date
promiseMap.gapOrApproval: Scope and offer changes require Nic approval; promised/shipped cases are not starts.

promiseMap.resetAction: Day-30 review for each eligible trial; offer recurring plan; carry later cohorts forward.
promiseMap.resetTarget: 1–3 recurring conditional on mature trial cohorts; all reviews scheduled
promiseMap.evidence: Signed plan, invoice/recurring status and actual review date
promiseMap.gapOrApproval: 90-day retention cannot mature inside this short reset; keep future cohort tracking.

promiseMap.proposalTarget: Approximately 7300 new target contacts over 6 months; real licensed LinkedIn identities
promiseMap.resetAction: Rebuild verified local list; coordinate 3 touches against one record; keep licensed/manual LI and real senders.
promiseMap.evidence: NPI/site/email/suppression evidence; identity authorization; unique contact IDs
promiseMap.gapOrApproval: 750 raw verified contacts do not count as 100 qualified inquiries.

promiseMap.proposalTarget: Sales owner qualification within 1 business day
promiseMap.resetAction: Nova/setters respond<=15 min in confirmed PT coverage; positives called<=60 min; clinical/pricing questions to Nic.
promiseMap.evidence: Received/first-human-response timestamps; call task; qualification fields
promiseMap.gapOrApproval: Coverage must be named and funded; AI failure uses manual SOP.

promiseMap.resetAction: Wyline daily acceptance plus Friday decisions; source-based dashboard and cost per booking.
promiseMap.resetTarget: Daily actuals/evidence; weekly report; Dec 16 execution closeout
promiseMap.evidence: Timestamped tracker, accepted outputs and CRM reconciliation
promiseMap.gapOrApproval: Activities and tools are leading inputs; qualified inquiries/appointments/trials lead client readout.

promiseMap.proposalTarget: $1,053.98/month recommended; 40 outreach hours/month; separate approval for excluded work.
promiseMap.resetAction: Confirm internally funded recovery capacity, prioritize manual conversion and obtain separate approval for any new client costs.
promiseMap.evidence: Written internal resource allocation and any DSI budget approval; actual hours and confirmed rates.
promiseMap.gapOrApproval: The reset caps of 125 internal hours/week plus setters exceed the proposal’s 40 outreach hours/month. No surcharge or funding approval is assumed.

promiseMap.proposalTarget: Approach $200,000 MRR as a strategic stretch, recalculated from actual MRR per retained client.
promiseMap.resetAction: Measure paid recurring wins and actual cohort economics; do not claim that the recovery goal fulfills the MRR objective.
promiseMap.resetTarget: No new guaranteed revenue target; record actual recurring revenue when known
promiseMap.evidence: Actual retained-account MRR/gross margin from DSI
promiseMap.gapOrApproval: MRR/client and service capacity must be confirmed; first inquiry/booking/trial recovery has priority.

scheduleRules.clockNote: Local Pacific clock: PDT through October 31; PST from November 1. ISO dueAt stores the correct offset; do not treat all dates asUTC-08.
scheduleRules.officeStarts: Kenneth/Nova 13:00; Wyline/Joey/Dexter 16:00; Emman/Ludwig/Alvin/Brian/Ali/Chester 17:00. Setter/client times are separate coverage or requested handoffs.
scheduleRules.dueTimes: Handoff times are proposed planning cutoffs. Confirm availability at setup; do not infer unprovided shift end times. Wyline uses split DSI blocks within 15 h/week, not a continuous six-hour DSI shift.
scheduleRules.workload: Existing core caps retained; every task estimate includes reviews/reporting. Ali/Chester are proposed 2.5 h/week each. If workload exceeds capacity, Wyline reprioritizes optional work, records the change and preserves the true original deadline.
scheduleRules.offDays: All 18 weekend dates and proposed November 26–27 holiday dates explicitly appear. No mandatory deliverables; only agreed named exception coverage. December 19–20 do not extend campaign acquisition.
scheduleRules.completion: Ready → In progress → Review → Accepted only with evidence and reviewer. A date advancing does not complete a task. Overdue/Blocked stays visible; originalDueDate stays fixed; recoveryOwner/recoveryDate separately recorded.
scheduleRules.rescue: Owner records blocker, impact and help immediately. Wyline assigns a capable rescue owner and next checkpoint; response-SLA risk uses the named live backup immediately. Owner is not silently changed and missed work is not marked done.
scheduleRules.report: Every active assigned owner submits output/KPI/evidence/status/blocker/help/next owner/date. Zero is used only when observed; unknown stays blank. Customer outcomes use unique CQL IDs, not sensitive patient details.
scheduleRules.AI: AI may submit draft reports with task ID, measured result and evidence. Named human reviews and accepts; AI has no self-acceptance or implicit spend/sending authority.
scheduleRules.social: 20 original posts:10 Engage/6 Educate/4 Promote. Mirrors do not count as additional originals. Wyline calendar/strategy; Kenneth content; Emman AI production; Dexter/Alvin publishing; Nova/setters conversion.
scheduleRules.media: Wyline owns setup and conversion optimization. Spend 0 until written approval and tested tracking/routing. Source proposed limits 15/day,450 total; stop at 300 with 0 attributed bookings; onebooking at 300 requires review, not automatic continuation.
scheduleRules.import: Map CSV/JSON into the existing system; no import capability is assumed. Match stable IDs. Do not overwrite live actuals, evidence, status, original due date, review history or accepted timestamps with blank planning values.
